Legacy D0.cpp/D1.cpp were already plain out-of-line daObjBC_Switch_c::~daObjBC_Switch_c(){} redefinitions (no ICE, same shape as daChRoom_c/#1725 and daObjCannonShutter_c/#1730) -- deleted D0's duplicate body. tubuild create flagged two false-positive conflicts on _ZN10dBgActor_c21UpdateModelPosAndRotYEv/_ZN10dBgActor_c19UpdateClsnPosAndRotEv (parameter-NAME-only differences between the legacy Behavior and InitResources files, same extern "C" void(void*) type both times) -- confirmed byte-neutral, kept one spelling. decl_common.h's own declaration of func_ov002_020f15b8 was stale/wrong (extern void func_ov002_020f15b8(void); -- zero args, vs. the real 3-arg definition every legacy .c/.cpp file using it already agreed on) -- fixed the shared header directly since the only other reference takes this function's address (immune to the arity mismatch) and no call site anywhere in the tree relied on the wrong zero-arg spelling.
